================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: BEGIN ... END and a select
================================================================================

begin
  null;
  null;
end;
select 3 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: DECLARE ... BEGIN ... END
================================================================================

DECLARE
  v NUMBER := 0;
  s VARCHAR2(10) := 'x';
BEGIN
  :total := v;
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(s);
END;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (string)
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: nested blocks
================================================================================

BEGIN
  BEGIN
    NULL;
  END;
  DECLARE
    w NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    w := 1;
  END inner_block;
  <<outer>>
  BEGIN
    :x := 2;
  END;
END;
SELECT 2 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a BEGIN that starts a transaction in a block
================================================================================

BEGIN
  BEGIN WORK;
  NULL;
  begin transaction;
  NULL;
  Begin;
  NULL;
END;
SELECT 3 FROM dual;
DECLARE
  v NUMBER;
BEGIN
  BEGIN WORK;
  v := 1;
END;
SELECT 4 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: IF, LOOP and CASE inside a block
================================================================================

begin
  for i in 1 .. 3 loop
    if i > 1 then
      null;
    elsif i = 1 then
      null;
    end if;
  end loop;
  while true loop
    exit;
  end loop;
  case 1
    when 1 then null;
  end case;
  x := case when 1 > 0 then 1 else 0 end;
end;
select 4 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a line with only a slash does not end the block
================================================================================

BEGIN
  NULL;
END
/
SELECT 5 FROM dual;
DECLARE
  v NUMBER;
BEGIN
  v := 1;
  /
SELECT 6 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a slash that is not alone on its line
================================================================================

BEGIN
  x := 6
  / 2;
  y := 1 /
  3;
END;
SELECT 7 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a comment before the block
================================================================================

-- a comment
/* another comment */ Begin
  null;
End;
select 8 from dual;

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: statements that do not start a block
================================================================================

SELECT 1 FROM dual;
UPDATE t SET a = 1 WHERE b IN (SELECT c FROM u);
INSERT INTO t (begin_date) VALUES (SYSDATE);
SELECT 2 FROM dual
/

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a slash after the ; of a block is text
================================================================================

declare
  x number;
begin
  x := 1;
end;
/
select 'last' as s from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement)
  (statement
    (string)))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a slash after the ; of a procedure is text
================================================================================

create or replace procedure p as begin null; end;
/
select 1 from dual;

  (statement))

Oracle anonymous blocks: a slash does not end a statement with no ;

/
select 2 from dual;

  (statement))

/

) from dual;

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a function whose inner ; is escaped as \;
================================================================================

select 1 from dual;
